items.name: A Bruin Cube Day 2022
items.information: This competition is hosted by Cubing Club at UCLA. If you are under the age of 18 by the date of the competition, your registration will not be accepted unless you fill out the following waiver: https://forms.gle/4V9qfmUBjZCZJFxMA This is a **series competition** with [Long Beach Spring 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LongBeachSpring2022) and [Geffen Spring 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeffenSpring2022/). You will only have your registration accepted for one competition in the series.

items.name: Madryn al Cubo 2022

venue.name: Bajada 9 - Parador Municipal
venue.address: Bv. Almte Brown 3049, Puerto Madryn, Chubut

items.information: "Madryn al Cubo 2022" contará con **7 categorias** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) y **11 rondas** en total. El objetivo es que los competidores de la region puedan actualizar sus tiempos y seguir mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado el [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019) y el [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) con gran éxito. El cupo maximo de competidores será de 25, con **1 acompañante como maximo** (padre, madre, hermano, tutor, amigo, etc) pudiendose anotar a todas las categorias que deseen pagando 1 sola inscripcion. **Se ruega puntualidad**. Recomendamos llegar 15 minutos antes de cada ronda en la que vas a competir. *ENGLISH* "Madryn al Cubo 2022" will feature **7 categories** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) and **11 rounds** in total. The objective is that the competitors in the region can update their times and continue to improve. We have the experience of having organized [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019) and [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) with great success. The maximum capacity of competitors will be 25, with a **maximum of 1 companion** (father, mother, brother, guardian, friend, etc.) being able to enter all the categories that they wish by paying only 1 registration. **Punctuality is necessary**. We recommend arriving 15 minutes before each round in which you are going to compete.

items.name: Rose City First-Timers A 2022
items.information: This competition is a 3x3x3 only competition lasting half of the day. As there are no cutoffs and a maximum-sized second round, this is a competition targeted at those who are newer to cubing and WCA competitions, but **both new and returning cubers are welcome to register.** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoseCityFirstTimersA2022#17674-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!** [![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/8uf2SCt.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085/) This is a competition in a series with [Rose City 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoseCity2022) and [Rose City First-Timers B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoseCityFirstTimersB2022). You can only register for one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple competitions in this series will result in the organization team choosing which registration is valid on your behalf.
